description: This file implements a CalendarHandler class along with associated data classes and an internal data source object for managing calendar events in an Android app. It handles permission checks, querying, and adding calendar events via Android's CalendarContract provider, with JSON serialization/deserialization for parameters and responses.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles calendar event operations like querying and adding events, utilizing the CalendarDataSource interface.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for querying calendar events, including start/end timestamps and limit.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for adding a calendar event, including title, times, location, and calendar preferences.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event record with identifying info and details.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checks, event retrieval, and event addition to a calendar.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Processes request to fetch calendar events based on JSON parameters, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Processes request to add a calendar event based on JSON parameters, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a CalendarEventsRequest object with default time range if parameters are missing.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a CalendarAddRequest object.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses ISO string into an Instant.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JsonObject representation.
